floorPlans.introduction: Compare the one-, two- and three-bedroom layouts published by Nshama.
floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a Ayala on the Park apartment layout
floorPlans.note: Built-up totals include the balcony. Area ranges follow the printed values. The printed totals for 1 BR Type A and 3 BR Type A differ from rounded component sums by 0.01 sq ft. Confirm the size of the specific apartment.

review.gallery: 7 Nshama design renders and 4 actual construction photos from the developer’s September 2026 project update. A fit-out image also appears in the Grove update and was excluded from both galleries.
review.location: The Nshama master-plan panel and community estimate table are on physical pages 3 and 7. Continental Club (https://continentalclub.ae/project/ayala-the-park-town-square/) and Benham & Reeves (https://www.benhams.ae/off-plan-properties/dubai/ayala-on-the-park-town-square-532221/) place the project about 83 m apart. The Nshama drawing marks the plot without coordinates. Directions use the project name.
review.floorPlans: 8 complete sheets, with totals visually checked against the original drawing panels. The printed totals for 1 BR Type A and 3 BR Type A differ from rounded component sums by 0.01 sq ft.

unavailable: Verified visitor entrance, finished-building photos and current unit-specific measured areas.
